patthana21.12:1.1: na saññojanaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:2.1: hetuyā tīṇi. ganthagocchakaduka nakusalattike ganthagocchakaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.12:3.1: na ganthaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā gantho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:5.1: na oghaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ogho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:7.1: na yogaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā yogo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:8.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nīvaraṇagocchakaduka nakusalattike nīvaraṇagocchakaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.12:9.1: nanīvaraṇaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:11.1: na parāmāsaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.12:12.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasārammaṇaduka nakusalattike sārammaṇaduka kusalattikaṃ
